_comment: WS_Guests.'Session State' select options that exist in the LIVE Airtable base. Source: Claude.ai live-schema check, 01 Oct 2026 (Doc 1b). The app's Airtable token cannot create select options, so a state the code writes that is not listed here WILL fail silently in production (30 Sep outage: AWAITING_PAYMENT_METHOD). To add a state: Claude.ai creates the option in Airtable first, then this list is updated, then the code ships. test/sessionstateoptions.test.js fails the build if the code writes a state that is not listed.
